survey: A blue-grey headstone in three-quarter view, turned slightly to the right. Main parts: (1) An upright slab with a round arched top on the left. The top-right corner is broken off, and the break has a jagged, stepped edge that shows the stone's thickness. The right side face is visible and is the same thickness all the way down. (2) A raised cross carved in relief on the front face, upper left, standing out evenly from the surface. (3) A flat rectangular plinth under the slab. The slab sits squarely on the plinth with even margins on both sides and some margin in front. The plinth rests flat on the yellow ground and casts a soft contact shadow to the back right. Every part rests on the part below it. Nothing floats or passes through anything else. The broken corner reads as a deliberate break and its depth matches the slab's thickness.
